react.description: Text fields let users enter text into a UI.

tags.devx:
- Supports controlled (`value`) and uncontrolled (`defaultValue`) usage.
- `multiline` switches to an auto-growing textarea.
- `type="select"` switches to select mode with `options` or projected `MenuItem` children.
- `type="date"` switches to date-picker mode; the field stays typable (`YYYY-MM-DD`).
- `mask` transforms typed/pasted input on every keystroke (a card number, a phone number, an
  ID); it defaults to the built-in `YYYY-MM-DD` mask for `type="date"`, and providing one
  overrides it.
- The outlined variant's legend notch uses one `@udixio/core/dom` Anime.js Layout controller,
  shared with the Angular adapter -- an accepted exception to the rest of `@udixio/core/dom`,
  which uses Motion; Motion has no free equivalent to `width: auto` layout diffing. The floating
  label itself is a plain CSS transition.
tags.a11y:
- `aria-describedby` links supporting text/error to the input.
- `aria-invalid` reflects `errorText`.
tags.limitations: - `ref` targets the underlying `<input>`/`<textarea>`, not the field's root element.

label.name: label
label.description: Field label, floated above the value or notched into the outlined legend.

leadingIcon.name: leadingIcon
leadingIcon.description: Optional icon shown before the value.

trailingIcon.name: trailingIcon
trailingIcon.description:
Optional icon shown after the value. Defaults to a calendar indicator
for `type="date"` and a chevron indicator for `type="select"`.

suffix.name: suffix
suffix.description: Static text appended after the value, for example a unit. Hidden while an error icon is shown.

type.name: type
type.description:
Native input kind, or a UI mode: `'date'` opens a date picker and
`'select'` opens a menu of `options`.

className.name: className
className.description: Classes or state-aware element classes applied through the shared style contract.

autoFocus.name: autoFocus
autoFocus.description: Focuses the field once, on mount.

id.name: id
id.description: Id of the underlying form control. Auto-generated if not provided.

onFocus.name: onFocus
onFocus.description: Fires when the underlying control gains focus.

onBlur.name: onBlur
onBlur.description: Fires when the underlying control loses focus.

onChange.name: onChange
onChange.description: Called once for each accepted value transition.

multiline.name: multiline
multiline.description: Switches to an auto-growing multiline textarea.

value.name: value
value.description: Controlled value. Providing it makes the field controlled for its lifetime.

name.name: name
name.description: Name of the underlying form control.

placeholder.name: placeholder
placeholder.description: Placeholder shown only while the field is focused and empty.

errorText.name: errorText
errorText.description: Error message. Also switches the field to its error color treatment and shows an error icon.

mask.name: mask
mask.description:
Transforms typed or pasted input into the value, on every keystroke --
for example inserting separators as digits accumulate, or rejecting
characters outside an expected format (a card number, a phone number,
an ID). Defaults to the built-in `YYYY-MM-DD` mask
(`sanitizeTextFieldDateInput`) for `type="date"`; unset for every other
type. Providing one for `type="date"` replaces the built-in mask.

Must be idempotent (`mask(mask(x)) === mask(x)`): the field is
controlled, so `mask` receives its own previous output back as `raw` on
every subsequent keystroke. A literal you inject (a `+33` country code,
a fixed digit group) will be mistaken for freshly typed input on the
next call unless you strip it back out first -- inserted separators
that aren't valid data characters (a `-`, a space) don't need this,
since a naive filter already excludes them.

angular.description: Text fields let users enter text into a UI.

tags.devx:
- `value`/`valueChange` are controlled and support `[(value)]`; `defaultValue` initializes uncontrolled usage.
- `multiline` switches to an auto-growing textarea.
- `type="select"` switches to select mode with `options`; Angular has no equivalent to React's projected `MenuItem` children, so `options` is the only way to populate the menu.
- `type="date"` switches to date-picker mode; the field stays typable (`YYYY-MM-DD`).
- `mask` transforms typed/pasted input on every keystroke (a card number, a phone number, an
  ID); it defaults to the built-in `YYYY-MM-DD` mask for `type="date"`, and providing one
  overrides it.
- The outlined variant's legend notch uses one `@udixio/core/dom` Anime.js Layout controller, shared with the React adapter -- an accepted exception to the rest of `@udixio/core/dom`, which uses Motion; Motion has no free equivalent to `width: auto` layout diffing. The floating label itself is a plain CSS transition.
tags.a11y:
- `aria-describedby` links supporting text/error to the input.
- `aria-invalid` reflects `errorText`.
- The date/select trailing icon is a real `<button>` so it stays keyboard reachable.
tags.limitations: - Does not support projecting custom `MenuItem` content the way the React adapter does; use `options`.
